dataset.digest_note: CORRECTED 2026-09-15: the digest this record originally carried (d8ccf1970f67f657d7121b3586399d180c727e867055f1da7c73d73caebe67d1) was not independently computed -- it is v1's own recorded digest (b1-manifest-ab-2026-09.json's 62-hex-char string, itself uncomputed/unverified) with the two characters 'd1' appended to reach 64 hex chars, confirmed by exact prefix match. This field now holds a real sha256 of a real per-file listing (see digest_method). Corpus-identity evidence: v1's -logs/ recorded only the CSV input path (identical string in both b1a-control.log and b1a-treatment.log, and identical to the path used for this v2 record) -- no file listing, sizes, or hashes were recorded by v1. Every file's mtime in the freshly-generated listing is 2022-04-26 (LDBC dataset generation time), years before either the v1 (2026-09-14) or v2 (2026-09-15) run, which is consistent with (but does not prove) the corpus being unmodified across both runs; v1's placeholder digest carries no evidentiary weight either way.
